records.name: Gamelan Gita Santi
records.summary: A Balinese gamelan ensemble in South Philadelphia that teaches traditional Balinese music to community members. Players learn the parts, rehearse as a group, and join the fall concert and community events.
records.what_you_do: Learn to play gamelan parts in a group, rehearse on Thursday evenings, and take part in the fall concert.

schedule.text: Community sessions on Thursday evenings (6:15 to 8:15 pm) from late September to mid-November 2026, plus Saturday afternoon sessions at 1:30 pm on October 10, November 14 and November 21

cost.text: Not stated on the group's site

first_step.how: Text 215-254-4475 to register for the fall community sessions
first_step.basis: Community sessions take sign-ups by text and the site names no skill requirement

records.notes: The group's own page is current and titled for fall 2026. Cost and age limits are not stated. The WHYY page (updated Nov 25, 2024) covers a fall concert at PAX on Nov 23, 2024. Partners named on the site: Modero & Co., Gapura Philadelphia and Tom Whitman. Kind set to program because the legal form is not stated. Not the same group as Gamelan Semara Santi at Swarthmore.

records.name: Modero & Co.
records.summary: A community group founded in 2011 that shares Indonesian culture through dance and immersive public events. Its dancers perform at public festivals and at community concerts such as the gamelan fall concert.
records.what_you_do: Watch dance performances and festival sets, or sign up for the newsletter to hear about the next event.

schedule.text: Public events are listed by date, mostly in the afternoon or evening in late October and November. The site does not print a year next to the dates.

first_step.how: Attend one of the listed public events, or sign up for the newsletter on the group's site
first_step.basis: Events are public, but the site gives no class or join route beyond a newsletter, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: Found through the WHYY article's link to modero.co, since the name search returned nothing. Event listings on modero.co have no year, so the status rests on the WHYY report (updated Nov 25, 2024) that Modero dancers performed at the Nov 23, 2024 gamelan concert. One listed venue is American Dream, which I have not verified as in Philadelphia, so it is left out of locations. No classes are listed. Lead name was Modero & Company.

records.name: Awbury Arboretum Association
records.summary: The group that cares for Awbury Arboretum, a free public garden and farm in Northwest Philadelphia. It runs public walks, workshops and festivals, children's day camps, and takes on volunteers.
records.what_you_do: Join a wellness walk or a farm workshop, bring children to a day camp, or sign up to volunteer on the grounds.

schedule.text: Grounds are open free every day from dawn to dusk. Listed events run from October 2026 to May 2027, including a wellness walk, a harvest festival, and school day off camps.

cost.text: Grounds are free. Camp and program fees are not stated on the pages I read.

first_step.how: Email volunteer@awbury.org or call 215-849-2855 to ask about volunteering, or check the events calendar for a walk or farm workshop
first_step.basis: Grounds and some walks are open to anyone, and volunteers are invited to get in touch, though no volunteer roles are listed on the page

records.notes: The events calendar lists about ten dated events from October 2026 to May 2027, most open to the public, and the children's camps need registration. The volunteer page names no roles and gives 215-843-2855, which differs from the 215-849-2855 printed in the site footer; the footer number is used here. The Cope House Gallery is listed as a public space.

records.name: Center for Emerging Visual Artists (CFEVA)
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that supports visual artists. Its free Philadelphia Open Studio Tours each October let the public visit working artists' studios across the city, and it also runs gallery shows, artist talks and receptions.
records.what_you_do: Visit artists' studios on the tour weekends, come to exhibition openings and talks, or help deliver tour maps and materials as a volunteer.

schedule.text: Free Open Studio Tours on two October weekends, noon to 6 pm: October 10 to 11 and October 17 to 18, 2026, split by west and east of Broad Street. Gallery openings and artist talks run through the year.

cost.text: Open studio tours are free. Some receptions and parties are ticketed or have a cash bar.

first_step.how: Pick studios from the free tour map on cfeva.org, or email info@cfeva.org to ask about volunteering on tour weekends
first_step.basis: Tours are free and open to anyone, and the site explains how to plan a route; artist membership needs sign-up

records.notes: The events page gives the 2026 tour weekends with the year written, and the POST page itself prints no year beside its dates. Older addresses (237 S 18th St) are out of date. Mailing address on the site: The Philadelphia Building, 1315 Walnut St, Suite 300. Prior fall tours ran in 2024 and 2025 per the events page, and the 2025 Art Party was ticketed. The number of studios is not stated.

records.name: Azuka Theatre
records.summary: A new play company that sells tickets to its own productions. Its site lists no classes, volunteer roles or community casts, and does not say that its readings are open to the public.
records.notes: Checked the site: the 2026 to 2027 season (#CHARLOTTESVILLE, Oct 15 to Nov 1, 2026; Play On!, Apr 22 to May 9, 2027, both at the Louis Bluver Theatre at The Drake, ticketed on a pay what you decide basis), Rising Writers and New Play Development (playwright development, with scripts submitted through an online form), and a calendar. Not published because the public way in is buying tickets or submitting a script, not a community program. Revisit if it lists open readings, volunteer roles or classes. Its Stages in Education school program appears on older pages but not on the current site.

records.name: Tibetan Association of Philadelphia (Sunday school)
records.notes: Lead was 'Tibetan Sunday school (Philadelphia)'. The Inquirer (Feb 24, 2024) says the Tibetan Association of Philadelphia runs weekly, volunteer-run Tibetan language classes for children, and WHYY (Dec 3, 2023) reports the association's Norristown center will house the school. Earlier classes met in Philadelphia churches and a Germantown meeting room. Verdict is out of area because the school now meets in Norristown (Montgomery County). No schedule, contact or join route was published in what I could read, and no website was found. Could be revisited if classes return to Philadelphia or the association publishes a way to join.

records.name: The Barley Sheaf Players
records.notes: Community theater at 810 N Whitford Rd, Lionville (Chester County). Its own about page describes serving the region around Lionville and does not mention Philadelphia. Not published.

records.name: Bucks County Choral Society
records.notes: Auditioned choir based in Bucks County, with rehearsals and outreach in Doylestown. Its site presents it as a local alternative to commuting to New York or Philadelphia, so it does not meet in or serve the city. Its open programs (Singing for a Lifetime workshop, Voices of the Future student competition, Big Sing) are all in Bucks County. Not published.

records.name: Community Arts Center
records.notes: The one matching organization found is at 414 Plush Mill Rd, Wallingford, in Delaware County, per its CauseIQ listing. No own website was found, so its programs are not verified. Not published.

records.name: Liberian Women's Chorus for Change
records.notes: The newest dated page I read is a Philadelphia Folklore Project article dated Jan 15, 2016 (the chorus is that project's initiative). A WHYY article dated June 23, 2014 covers a benefit concert. No way to join or attend was found and no own website is linked, so it is hidden for having no public way in. Revisit if the chorus or its initiator publishes current performances or a way to join.

records.name: Cambodian American Girls Empowering (CAGE)
records.notes: Lead named the youth dance troupe. The only coverage I found is from 2018 (one blog spells the acronym CASE). The parent, Cambodian Association of Greater Philadelphia (cagp.org, read Oct 8, 2026), does not mention the troupe. Its site lists a High School Youth Program and Out-of-School Time Programs with no schedule or sign-up steps. Hidden for having no public way in that I could find. The parent is in leads_only for a check of those youth programs.

records.name: Contemporary Black Canvas
records.notes: A podcast of long interviews with Black artists and makers, hosted by one person. Search results date its coverage to 2016 to 2018. The Creative Colab project list does not include it. It has no members, classes or volunteer roles, and a 2017 artists' roundtable was a one-time event. Not published.

leads_only.name: Gapura Philadelphia
leads_only.note: Co-hosted the Nov 23, 2024 gamelan concert and is named as a partner of Gamelan Gita Santi. Not checked.

leads_only.name: Cambodian Association of Greater Philadelphia
leads_only.note: Parent of the CAGE youth dance troupe per 2018 coverage. Its site lists a High School Youth Program and Out-of-School Time Programs with no schedules. Not checked for a record.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Folklore Project
leads_only.note: Initiator of the Liberian Women's Chorus for Change and host of residency pages. Not checked.

notes: All 12 names were searched once each (12 of 12 WebSearch used). 31 WebFetch calls used. Verdicts: 4 publish (Gamelan Gita Santi, Modero & Co., Awbury Arboretum Association, CFEVA), 2 not_a_group (Azuka Theatre, Contemporary Black Canvas), 4 out_of_area (Tibetan Association of Philadelphia Sunday school, The Barley Sheaf Players, Bucks County Choral Society, Community Arts Center), 2 hide (Liberian Women's Chorus for Change and Cambodian American Girls Empowering, both out_of_scope for no public way in). Judgment calls for the owner: Azuka is hidden as not_a_group because its public way in is ticket sales and script submissions, not a community program; the Tibetan school moved to Norristown, so it is out of area; the two hidden groups have no join route or current dates. The Tibetan Sunday school lead was searched without its parenthetical. No 403 or bot-check pages were hit, and no portal.philaculture.org pages were fetched. Budget was not exhausted on fetches.
